title: Cfp automation specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cfp automation specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role We are a growing Registered Investment Advisor (RIA) seeking a highly skilled offshore CFP with strong technical aptitude and process‐automation experience. The ideal candidate will support our advisory team by improving internal workflows and leveraging technology to automate routine tasks within our wealth‐management operations. This role is ideal for someone who can blend financial-planning expertise with systems thinking, helping us scale efficiently while maintaining a high‐touch client experience. Key Responsibilities Process Automation & Systems Optimization Identify recurring tasks and workflows that can be automated within CRM, custodian platforms, and planning tools. Build or enhance automation using RIA technology such as: Practifi (e.g., Salesforce, Practifi) Workflow tools (Jump, Zapier, Co-Pilot) Planning software integrations Portfolio management systems Custodian Platforms (Charles Schwab, Fidelity, TIAA-CREF) Document new and existing processes to ensure repeatability and team adoption. Collaboration & Communication Work closely with lead advisors, operations staff, and service teams. Provide clear written updates and status tracking on workflow progress. Participate in virtual team meetings and recommend improvements proactively. Qualifications Required CFP certification (or international equivalent recognized by FPSB). 3+ years of experience in financial planning, wealth management, or RIA operations. Strong understanding of investment products, retirement planning, advanced financial planning tools, and wealth‐management essentials. Demonstrated experience using financial planning software. Proven ability to create or implement workflow automation Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. High attention to detail and ability to work independently. Preferred Experience working with U. S.-based RIAs. Familiarity with custodians such as Schwab, Fidelity, or TIAA-CREF. Understanding of RIA compliance workflows and documentation standards. Exposure to portfolio management tools (Orion, Advyzon). Ability to document SOPs and create workflow diagrams. What We Offer Competitive compensation based on experience and skillset. Up to $50 an hour. Flexible schedule to collaborate with U. S.-based team. Training and access to industry-leading financial technology. Opportunity to meaningfully contribute to the automation backbone of a growing RIA. Equal Opportunity Employer We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Founding engineer (path to cto)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Founding engineer (path to cto) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

SOBRE A VAGA A Hamurabi Apps está contratando uma pessoa engenheira, builder, intensa e extremamente dona pra ser nossa CTO fundadora. A vaga tem um arco claro. Nos primeiros 3-6 meses, você é, na prática, Founding Engineer: codando todos os dias, polindo os 5 produtos até estado lançável, construindo infra compartilhada e operando produto em produção. Conforme a receita aparece e o time cresce, você assume o papel pleno de CTO: contratação, arquitetura, mentoria, direção técnica, e cada vez menos código diário. Vaga founding, equity-only. Você trabalha direto com o Pablo (founder da Izzicupo Borges, que adquiriu a Hamurabi) e com o Founding Operator, que vamos trazer em paralelo. SNAPSHOT • Localização: Remoto Brasil + workshops/sprints ocasionais em Uberlândia/MG (sede da Izzicupo Borges) • Modelo: equity-only no início, com gatilhos claros de receita destravando comp fixa (detalhe em POTENCIAL DE GANHO) • Equity: 15% founding-level (vesting 4 anos, cliff 1 ano, reverse vesting, bad leaver clauses padrão) • Bônus por milestone de produto: definidos caso a caso (ship de novo micro-app, atingir SLA-alvo, escalar 10x usuários) • Path to CTO consolidado: Cargo se consolida com 3+ engenheiros sob você e infra em produção com SLA • Perfil: full-stack sênior ou staff, AI-native, customer-obsessed, confortável codando legal-tech, dev-tools, cloud, ERP e agentes no mesmo mês O QUE FAZEMOS A Hamurabi Apps é um estúdio de micro-apps. Nascemos como software house low-code/no-code (Bubble Silver Partner). Em 2025, fomos adquiridos pela Izzicupo Borges e estamos relançando a tese: portfólio focado de produtos com receita recorrente, todos construídos, operados e licenciados sob o mesmo teto, com infra compartilhada e distribuição cruzada. Cinco micro-apps medianos rendendo R$ 30k de MRR cada batem uma startup média lutando por PMF. Portfólio atual (5 produtos não lançados publicamente): • Análise de risco jurídico em contratos com NLP, pra escritórios e jurídicos in-house • Analytics de performance de engenharia com IA, pra times técnicos e CTOs • Plataforma de automação e infra cloud, pra times que orquestram deploy e workflows • ERPs sob medida pra PMEs (gestão financeira, fiscal, operacional) • Agente que constrói landing pages do zero a partir de prompt NOSSA MISSÃO Provar que dá pra construir uma fábrica brasileira de software AI-native gerando milhões em ARR com time pequeno, intenso e dono. A maioria dos estúdios brasileiros nasce com cara de incubadora, escritório bonito, demo day e zero produto rodando. A Hamurabi nasce do oposto: produto primeiro, narrativa depois. COMO É O DIA A DIA Você não vai herdar uma engenharia rodando, vai construí-la. Não tem head of eng, QA dedicado, Dev Ops. Tem o Pablo (founder, também codador), o Founding Operator (que vamos trazer em paralelo), 1 dev pleno e os 5 produtos com graus diferentes de maturidade. A pessoa certa abre issue do produto jurídico às 9h, faz code review do dev pleno às 11h, refatora o RAG do produto de analytics à tarde, sobe deploy do produto de cloud à noite, e no dia seguinte abre PR de uma abstração compartilhada que vai servir o próximo micro-app. NÃO APLIQUE SE VOCÊ: • Espera receber arquitetura desenhada e sprint planejado. Aqui você É o arquiteto e o planner • Precisa de salário fixo grande. A base é zero no início. Dinheiro vem da equity, gatilhos e milestones • Não codifica em produção há mais de 6 meses. A vaga é hands-on do dia 1 • Tem ego de cargo. Você vai escrever código, fazer deploy, debugar produção, code review, JD, tudo, sozinho, no começo • Não usa IA pra programar (Cursor, Claude, MCP). Aqui IA escreve a maior parte do boilerplate • Tem medo de mexer em múltiplas linguagens/stacks ao mesmo tempo (TS, Python, infra, AI, frontend) • Precisa de processo todo desenhado e backlog todo grooming antes de começar • Não topa ambiente de altíssima exigência. Acompanhamos ship rate, uptime e qualidade semanalmente desde o dia 1 O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER Construir e shippar (responsabilidade #1, sobretudo nos primeiros 3-6 meses): • Polir os 5 produtos do portfólio até estado lançável (UX, performance, billing, onboarding, observabilidade) • Codar diariamente em produção. Backend, frontend, infra, AI, integrações: você cobre tudo • Estabelecer infra compartilhada (billing, auth, observability, analytics) entre os 5 produtos • Subir o que quebrar, otimizar o que estiver lento, refatorar o que estiver podre Operar e escalar (escopo cresce a partir do mês 3): • Uptime, SLAs, segurança, custo de infra, CI/CD, observabilidade, on-call • Migrar/desmontar o que sobrou de Bubble pra stack code-first quando fizer sentido • Construir abstrações reutilizáveis pro próximo micro-app entrar com fricção mínima Construir time e arquitetura (escopo cresce a partir do mês 6): • Contratar a guilda de founding builders na medida em que a receita destrava • Formar e mentorar o dev pleno e os juniors que já estão no radar • Definir padrões de código, arquitetura, testing, code review, documentação • Trabalhar com o Pablo na visão técnica e com o Founding Operator na priorização de produto STACK Code-first, AI-native, enxuto. Stack atual (e onde queremos chegar): Type Script (Node.js, Nest JS, Next.js, React) · Python (Fast API, NLP, agentes) · Postgre SQL · vector DBs (Weaviate, Chroma DB) · Open AI, Anthropic, Lang Chain · AWS, Vercel, Railway, Docker · Git Hub Actions · Cursor, Claude e MCP pra programar todo dia · Stripe pra billing · Bubble (legacy, vamos migrar/desmontar conforme fizer sentido). Você não precisa ter usado tudo. Precisa ser muito confortável aprendendo rápido e operando full-stack de verdade. QUALIFICAÇÕES MÍNIMAS • 5+ anos construindo software em produção, com pelo menos 1 produto B2 B sério no histórico • Domínio de Type Script + Python (ou conforto absoluto pra ir e vir entre os dois) • Experiência com banco relacional, APIs, auth, deploy, logs e debugging em produção • Capacidade de ir do problema de negócio ao código sem travar • Uso intenso de IA pra programar, pesquisar, documentar, testar, prototipar e automatizar • Tolerância a risco real: você topa equity-only no início em troca de equity founding-level e cargo de CTO • Capacidade de fazer deep work técnico E pensamento de arquitetura no mesmo dia, sem confundir os dois DIFERENCIAIS • Já ter sido founding engineer ou CTO #1 de startup que atingiu PMF • Já ter operado portfolio (multi-produto, multi-stack) em estúdio, agência ou holding • Experiência com IA em produção: prompts, evals, guardrails, latência, custo, RAG, multi-agent • Experiência com migração/sunset de plataforma low-code (Bubble, Webflow) pra stack code-first • Já ter contratado, formado e liderado time de 3 a 10 engenheiros • Vontade real de virar CTO de verdade: visão, hiring, board, captação, demissão COMO MEDIMOS SUCESSO Indicadores mudam ao longo da rampa. title: Sr ai engineer - brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr ai engineer - brazil em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Senior AI Engineer PITZ | Remote | Reports to CTOA trillion-dollar industry still runs on phone calls. We're building the intelligence that replaces it. PITZ is the infrastructure layer for the global automotive aftermarket. A mechanic speaks — in Spanish, Portuguese, or English, in a noisy shop — and our system diagnoses the failure, identifies the exact part, selects the supplier, underwrites credit, and executes the order. No screen. No typing. No human in the loop. We're live in Mexico and Brazil. Entering the US this year. And we need someone to build the brain behind all of it. Why this role exists
We're not hiring a cog for an AI team. There is no AI team yet. You'd be the first dedicated AI hire. You'll work directly with the CEO to design and build the entire intelligence layer — voice pipeline, recommendation engine, credit scoring, and the data flywheel that makes everything compound. If you deliver, you become Head of AI within 12 months. Not as a title bump — because you'll have built the thing from scratch and no one will know it better than you. This is a role for someone who's been a Senior ML Engineer or AI Lead somewhere and knows they're ready for more — but hasn't had the chance to prove it because there's always someone above them. Here, there's no one above you. Just the problem and the product. What you'll build
The voice-to-action pipeline. Mechanic speech in noisy shops → intent extraction → diagnostic prediction → SKU mapping from millions of parts → order execution. Three languages. Regional slang. Background noise. Real world, not a lab. The recommendation engine. Right part, right seller, right price, right delivery. This is where margin lives. Every percentage point of improvement moves real revenue. The credit scoring models. Behavioral underwriting for mechanics with no credit history. Turn operational data — order frequency, payment patterns, voice engagement — into financial signals. The data flywheel. Every interaction makes the system smarter. You design the architecture that turns daily transactions into compounding intelligence. US market integrations. Connect PITZ to Identifix, ALLDATA, OBD platforms, Parts Tech, Mitchell1. Adapt models for the US vehicle fleet and English-speaking mechanics. What you bring
3-5 years building ML/AI systems in production. Not notebooks. Not demos. Systems that real users interact with daily and that break in interesting ways. NLP or voice experience. You've worked with speech recognition, intent extraction, text classification, or conversational AI. Bonus if it was in noisy, multilingual, or domain-specific environments. Full-stack ML instincts. You can train a model, build the data pipeline, optimize inference, deploy it, and monitor it. You don't wait for a platform team — you are the platform team. Builder mentality. You've worked in startups or fast-moving environments. You ship fast. You make decisions with 70% of the data. You'd rather build something imperfect today than plan something perfect for next quarter. Fluent English required. Spanish or Portuguese strongly preferred. You'll work with mechanics, ops teams, and partners across three countries. Requirements
Timezone: Must be available during US/Lat Am business hours (UTC-3 to UTC-8). This is a real-time collaboration role, not async. Commitment: This is a full-time, dedicated position. If you're currently juggling multiple roles — this isn't a fit. We need 100%. Travel: Periodic travel to Mexico City and São Paulo. You'll visit workshops, hear mechanics, and see the product in action. If you've never left your desk to watch a user interact with your model — this will change that. What makes this different
At most companies, a Senior AI Engineer optimizes a model inside a product someone else designed. Here, you design the product. The intelligence layer IS the product. There's no PM handing you a spec. There's no VP of AI telling you the roadmap. You figure out what to build, you build it, and you see it run a real supply chain the next day. You'll work with proprietary data that doesn't exist anywhere else — millions of real mechanic-to-system interactions mapped to parts, orders, payments, and outcomes. Your models get better not because of more compute, but because of more reality. And if you prove you can own this — you lead the team we build around it.

Timezone: Must be available during US/Lat Am business hours (UTC-3 to UTC-8). This is a real-time collaboration role, not async. Commitment: This is a full-time, dedicated position. If you're currently juggling multiple roles — this isn't a fit. We need 100%. Travel: Periodic travel to Mexico City and São Paulo. You'll visit workshops, hear mechanics, and see the product in action. If you've never left your desk to watch a user interact with your model — this will change that. What makes this different
At most companies, a Senior AI Engineer optimizes a model inside a product someone else designed. Here, you design the product. The intelligence layer IS the product. There's no PM handing you a spec. There's no VP of AI telling you the roadmap. You figure out what to build, you build it, and you see it run a real supply chain the next day. You'll work with proprietary data that doesn't exist anywhere else — millions of real mechanic-to-system interactions mapped to parts, orders, payments, and outcomes. Your models get better not because of more compute, but because of more reality. And if you prove you can own this — you lead the team we build around it.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Growth project manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Localização Remoto Tipo de Contrato Prestação de Serviços (PJ) Sobre a vaga Procuramos Project Manager pra coordenar a execução das contas de growth da agência. A pessoa é o motor que transforma estratégia em entrega: traduz decisão em brief, distribui pra especialistas (conteúdo, criação, dev, mídia paga, etc), garante prazo, antecipa bloqueio e mantém o cliente com a sensação de que tudo está rodando. Não é função de atendimento estratégico. Estratégia é definida pelo especialista em growth. Você é quem garante que ela vira realidade no prazo certo, com qualidade. Atendemos clientes B2 B no Brasil e nos Estados Unidos, então parte da operação acontece em inglês. O que você vai fazer no dia a dia Traduzir decisões estratégicas (vindas de call ou clip gravado no Click Up) em briefs claros pros especialistas Coordenar sprints quinzenais de cada cliente, do planning à entrega Cobrar prazo e qualidade dos especialistas internos sem virar atrito Manter o Click Up como fonte única de verdade: tasks atualizadas, status correto, prazos visíveis Antecipar bloqueios e escalar pro Growth Lead antes de virar problema com cliente Participar de reuniões internas e produzir artefatos (atas com decisões e planos de ação) Cuidar de comunicação operacional com cliente (status report, follow-up de aprovação, agendamento) em português e inglês Identificar pontos de fricção no processo da agência e propor melhoria O que você precisa ter vivido +2 anos coordenando projetos, idealmente em agência, consultoria ou ops de startup Inglês fluente, escrito e falado. Você vai conduzir reuniões, escrever status reports e trocar mensagens com clientes nos EUA Comunicação escrita clara e objetiva em português e inglês (vamos pedir exemplo nos dois idiomas no processo seletivo) Domínio de Click Up. Operamos 100% no Click Up, então fluência aqui acelera muito a entrada Capacidade de cobrar prazo de pessoa mais sênior tecnicamente sem perder a mão Organização obsessiva: você é a pessoa que nunca esquece follow-up Diferencial, mas não obrigatório Experiência prévia em agência de marketing ou growth Vivência atendendo cliente internacional, especialmente nos EUA Familiaridade com vocabulário de growth B2 B (funil, ABM, mídia paga, lifecycle) Vivência em automatização de processo (Zapier e agentes do Click Up) O que não esperamos Não precisa ter experiência executando campanha, escrevendo copy ou desenhando estratégia. Esse não é o papel. Se você gosta mais de operar do que criar conteúdo de growth, é pra você. Boa parte do processo de operação está sendo desenhada agora, e quem entrar nesse momento influencia como a agência vai funcionar daqui pra frente. Se você curte ambiente em construção e quer deixar marca no processo, vai gostar. Se prefere chegar em estrutura totalmente pronta, esse provavelmente não é o melhor momento. Se você se reconheceu na descrição e quer construir esse processo junto, candidate-se aqui: Df0

title: Arte finalista (pleno/sênior)- banco de talentos
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Arte finalista (pleno/sênior)- banco de talentos em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem somos: A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção global digital, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência. O que buscamos: Estamos em busca de um arte-finalista capaz de trabalhar com rapidez, eficiência e mantendo grande atenção aos detalhes. O profissional deve ser altamente organizado e conseguir trabalhar em mais de um projeto ao mesmo tempo. Entre as atividades, a principal será fazer ajustes e alterações de cor, formato, texto, imagens e preparação dos arquivos para impressão (com sangria, marcas de corte e ficha técnica). O candidato precisa ter um conhecimento avançado no Adobe In Design já que 95% do trabalho será feito nele, e o nível de inglês para escrita e interpretação de texto também precisa ser avançado. A atividade diária principal será receber artes prontas das agências dos EUA para executar ajustes (no In Design) conforme comentários (em inglês) feitos no PDF. Além disso, será necessário também montar facas especiais e fazer o envio dos arquivos para a gráfica. Num primeiro momento o profissional estará sob supervisão para garantir o entendimento e fluxo de funcionamento do estúdio, mas com o passar do tempo a idéia é ganhar autonomia para realizar as tarefas mais cotidianas e recorrentes sem muita supervisão. Pré-Requisitos: Experiência comprovada no segmento impresso e em todos os detalhes que o meio exige (marcas de corte, sangría, margens de segurança, dobras, vinco, cores CMYK, facas especiais, e fichas técnicas); Graduação em Design Gráfico, Desenho Industrial ou áreas correlatas. Experiência de pelo menos 5+ anos na função como designer gráfico no ramo impresso. Domínio dos software In Design e illustrator; Inglês avançado (com comprovação via teste ao vivo na segunda etapa do processo); Disponibilidade para trabalhar das 10h as 19h ou das 13h as 22h. Será um diferencial se você tiver: Ter atuado ativamente com fechamento de arquivos, arte-final e preparação de arquivos para impressão. Conhecimento em softwares de gestão de tarefas como Monday ou Trello (aqui utilizamos Work Front); Está preparado(a) para cultivar novas experiências em um time que joga junto e valoriza o melhor de cada um(a)? #VEMSERSTUDIORX -- Consideramos todas as aplicações para nossas vagas sem distinção de gênero, orientação sexual, etnia, cultura, origem, religião, deficiência, idade etc. Acreditamos na construção de um mundo mais diverso, com mais representatividade e livre de preconceitos. Aqui você encontra um ambiente diverso, colaborativo e inclusivo que promove o desenvolvimento por meio das conexões humanas!

title: Content creator (paid ads)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Content creator (paid ads) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Reci Me is a recipe app revolutionizing how cooks organize, plan and shop their recipes. Our smart importing tool enables users to aggregate all their recipes in one platform within seconds - whether those recipes came from an Instagram video, recipe blog or grandma's recipe box. We've been a Top 10 app in the US App Store's Food category for months and were recently featured on The Drew Barrymore Show. We're bringing on a Paid Ad Content Creator to help us reach food lovers across your native-speaking language and fluent in English markets on Tik Tok, Meta, and You Tube. This role is for you if: You're fluent in English and your native country's language — and your content proves it You have 1–3 years of experience creating social media ads that actually perform You own the full process: scripting, filming, and editing You have a real track record of viral food and cooking content You know what makes an ad work on social media channels like Meta, Tik Tok and You Tube. What the process looks like No rounds of interviews. No lengthy back-and-forths. One call. Five of your best creatives that prove virality or conversion. That's how we'll know. If your work speaks for itself, we want to hear from you! To apply please submit application here: CUugq Qo Uyw Ee7

Comfortable with vibe coding, working interactively with AI to explore approaches, refine implementations, and quickly converge on production‐ready outcomes. Proven ability to deliver high output in sprint‐based development environments, consistently meeting or exceeding expectations for scoped work and story point delivery. title: Landing page designer, conversion focused
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Landing page designer, conversion focused em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you looking for an opportunity to make an incredible impact in the world of socially conscious brands? Lucyd Media is a social advertising agency, specializing in the compliant advertising for CBD, Cannabis, and other DTC wellness e-commerce brands. Our mission is to reduce human suffering and maximize human potential by facilitating the distribution of Conscious Compounds TM We are currently seeking a strong landing page (LP) designer to lead the design and optimization of the post-click experience across our paid media funnels. At Lucyd, we believe the post-click experience is one of the biggest underutilized levers in wellness growth. We need someone who can bring real authority to that part of the funnel, move quickly, use AI aggressively, and help us create a more seamless conversion experience across the brands we serve. This role will use AI-assisted tools to rapidly generate and iterate on landing pages, while applying strong design judgment and conversion strategy. Ready to elevate your career? We're excited to hear from you. What You Will Be Responsible For: Designing and optimizing landing pages, offer pages, and funnel-specific product pages Translating ad hooks and offer strategy into conversion-focused page experiences Improving what users land on after the click, whether that is a custom landing page, PDP variant, or other post-click experience Supporting page testing, iteration, and optimization based on performance Identifying where the current post-click experience is creating friction or hurting conversion Helping define how landing pages should be requested, built, and improved within Lucyd Using AI tools to speed up production and increase design leverage Partnering closely with Growth Strategists, Advertising, and Post-Click teams What We Are Looking For: 3+ years of experience in CRO-focused design, landing page design, funnel design, or conversion-oriented e Commerce design. A portfolio demonstrating at least 20 DTC/e Commerce landing pages or product pages (PDPs) you have designed. Candidates without relevant portfolio examples will not be considered. Experience designing for paid media funnels, not just general web design. You know how to align page structure and messaging to the promise made in the ad. Comfort using AI tools to generate and iterate on landing page designs quickly, while applying strong design judgment and strategic direction. You know how to use tools to move faster while still applying judgment and taste. Exceptional organizational skills, adept at juggling multiple projects while maintaining top-notch productivity and prioritization. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to manage client expectations and maintain strong relationships. Experience in DTC wellness supplements, cannabis or other restricted products or adjacent consumer categories is a plus Success Roadmap: In 30 Days, You'll: Audit the current pages users land on after the click, including landing pages, PDPs, collections, and offer pages. Identify the highest-priority opportunities to improve conversion through better post-click experiences. Begin improving the process for how landing pages are requested, built, and reviewed. Design and launch your first new landing pages for active client accounts. In 60 Days, You'll: Partner closely with Growth Strategists to align page structure with ad hooks, offers, and buyer intent. Start identifying patterns in what is driving or hurting conversion across pages. Own the design and optimization of post-click experiences for multiple active accounts. Contribute to a faster, more repeatable landing page production process In 90 Days, You'll: Be the clear internal owner of conversion-focused post-click design Establish a more seamless system for building, iterating, and optimizing landing pages. Consistently use AI tools to increase speed, output, and design leverage. Provide strong guidance to the team on what users should land on after they click on an ad. By Your One-Year Anniversary: You will have helped establish Lucyd's post-click experience as a meaningful performance lever across paid media. You will have contributed to: Faster landing page creation and iteration Higher-quality post-click experiences Better alignment between ads, offers, and page structure A more intentional system for designing and optimizing pages users land on after the click Apply now to become an integral part of our mission to connect socially conscious brands with their audiences in meaningful ways.

description:

Senior Website Designer Remote | Contract About BX Studio BX Studio is a digital agency specializing in website design, development, and optimization. We partner with clients in diverse sectors to create high-performing, visually compelling websites that drive results. Our service model is tuned for rapid delivery, building on Webflow, Framer and AI stacks. Our team is committed to delivering exceptional quality and maintaining long-term client relationships through ongoing strategic, creative and technical support. We pride ourselves on our collaborative culture, technical expertise, and dedication to staying at the forefront of web development best practices. BX Studio was recognized as Webflow Enterprise Partner of the Year 2025. Job description As a Web Designer at BX Studio, you will play a crucial role in leading the design and development of visually compelling and user-friendly websites for our clients. You will work closely with our clients, project managers, and development team to conceptualize, design, and implement custom web solutions that meet our clients' objectives and exceed their expectations. Descrição da Empresa Hospital Santa Casa de Patrocínio é uma instituição dedicada ao cuidado humanizado e à excelência no atendimento em saúde. Com anos de tradição, buscamos sempre oferecer serviços de qualidade, priorizando o bem-estar dos nossos pacientes e o desenvolvimento de nossos profissionais. Diferenciais: Graduação em administração, gestão hospitalar ou áreas afins, além de cursos relacionados à hotelaria hospitalar e experiência em instituições de saúde.

description:

About Bet Boom Bet Boom is a leading online gaming platform with a strong and growing presence in Latin America. Recently authorized by the Brazilian government to operate in the country, Bet Boom is at the forefront of the region's thriving i Gaming industry, offering an exceptional portfolio of sports betting, casino games, and live gaming experiences tailored to local markets. Our commitment to innovation, responsible gaming, and customer satisfaction drives us to deliver world-class entertainment while upholding our core values of integrity and excellence. With a dedicated focus on LATAM, Bet Boom is proud to contribute to the region's vibrant gaming landscape and to be a trusted partner for players and stakeholders alike. Join our team and help shape the future of online gaming in Brazil and beyond. Main Responsibilities Customer Service & Communication Represent Bet Boom professionally in all customer interactions via calls, chat, and email. Communicate clearly and empathetically, adjusting tone and terminology to match the customer's level of understanding. Ensure a customer-first approach by demonstrating patience, attentiveness, and a solution-oriented mindset. Manage conflicts calmly and constructively, offering appropriate and timely resolutions. Deliver high-quality service aligned with Bet Boom's standards, procedures, and regulatory requirements. Technical & Compliance Support Use internal systems and tools efficiently to process customer requests and inquiries. Perform customer identification (KYC) checks in accordance with internal protocols and compliance requirements. Access and apply knowledge from internal databases and resources to ensure fast, accurate responses. Stay informed of updates to internal policies and workflows via designated communication channels. Decision-Making & Escalation Diligently analyze customer issues and resolve them independently when possible. Identify and escalate suspected fraudulent activity or complex cases to appropriate departments. Report unresolved or frequent complaints to supervisors to support service improvement initiatives. Process & Quality Improvement Proactively suggest improvements to customer service processes and tools. Share insights and best practices with peers and management to elevate team performance. Participate actively in training programs, knowledge checks, and quality assessments to stay current with policies and procedures. Minimum Requirements Proven experience in customer service roles, preferably in i Gaming, fintech, or digital platforms. Proficient with CRM systems and customer support software. Solid understanding of Brazilian regulations related to online gaming and customer service. Advanced user of MS Office, internet browsers, and computer systems. Confident in operating both Android and i OS devices. Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with high typing speed and accuracy. Willingness to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays (24/7 rotation). Fluency in Portuguese and English (minimum B2 level). Proper home office setup, including: A quiet and distraction-free work environment A reliable and high-speed internet connection A computer capable of running necessary support systems and tools What We Offer Full-time (CLT) contract Remote work Health,dental and life insurance fully covered by the company Meal and Home Office Allowance Important Information: All resumes must be submitted in English.

Company Description Lasso MD is a service-based platform designed to simplify and enhance patient growth for healthcare practices. Through marketing services, communication software, and patient analytics, Lasso manages all stages of patient acquisition, from website design to ROI analysis. title: Executivo(a) comercial | feira de santana - bahia | liora energia
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Executivo(a) comercial | feira de santana - bahia | liora energia em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a Liora: Descomplicando a energia no Brasil Nascemos para simplificar a energia, algo essencial, mas que hoje parece distante e complexo. O brasileiro paga uma das contas de luz mais caras do mundo, muitas vezes sem saber que tem uma escolha. Quando descobre, a complexidade e a falta de transparência do setor geram desconfiança. A Liora chegou para mudar essa realidade. Nossa missão é provar que é possível ter acesso a uma energia mais barata e limpa com transparência, simplicidade e um atendimento genuinamente humano. Para nós, energia não é um produto técnico, é uma relação de confiança que devolve o poder para quem paga a conta. Essa transformação é construída por um time obcecado por seus clientes e que busca a excelência em tudo o que faz. Se você busca um propósito, quer construir algo gigante e acredita que o impossível é o nosso ponto de partida, seu lugar é aqui Sua Missão: Ser a Ponte Para um Futuro Energético Mais Justo Como Executivo(a) Comercial, você será a cara da Liora para nossos clientes, sendo peça-chave para estruturar e escalar nossos canais de vendas. Sua principal missão será levar a solução da Liora para pequenas e médias empresas e clientes residenciais que mais sentem o impacto da conta de luz no bolso e ainda não sabem que têm uma alternativa melhor. Você será a peça-chave para: Despertar o mercado para uma nova realidade energética. Ajudar clientes a tomar decisões com segurança e clareza. Construir relações de confiança que duram. Principais Responsabilidades: Desbravar o Mercado: Prospectar ativamente e qualificar novos clientes (PMEs e Residenciais), construindo um pipeline de oportunidades sólido e constante. Desenvolver Parcerias Estratégicas: Mapear, negociar e ativar redes de parceiros que nos ajudem a multiplicar nosso alcance e impacto. Realizar Vendas Consultivas: Entender profundamente as dores e necessidades dos clientes para apresentar a solução da Liora de forma personalizada e irresistível. Conduzir o Ciclo de Vendas Completo: Apresentar propostas de valor, negociar com clareza e fechar contratos que gerem valor real para os clientes e para a Liora. Atuar como a Voz do Cliente: Trazer feedbacks valiosos do mercado para colaborar com os times de Produto, Marketing e Pós-venda, nos ajudando a melhorar continuamente. O que Buscamos em Você: Perfil Hunter: Você tem energia, resiliência e paixão por abrir novas portas e prospectar clientes. Comunicação Excepcional: Habilidade de se comunicar de forma clara, direta e empática, criando conexões genuínas. Foco no Cliente: Uma obsessão por entender, resolver problemas e encantar quem está do outro lado da linha. Mentalidade de Dono(a): Autonomia para planejar, agilidade para executar e flexibilidade para ajustar a rota em busca dos melhores resultados. Ambição Gigante: O desejo de não apenas bater metas, mas de construir a maior e mais confiável provedora de serviços de energia do Brasil Nossa Proposta de Valor: Remuneração Sem Teto: Salário fixo competitivo + comissionamento agressivo e sem limites. Aqui, seu resultado define seu ganho. Plano de Saúde: Subsidiado pela empresa. Seguro de Vida. Vale-Refeição/Alimentação. Vale-Transporte ou Auxílio Deslocamento. E aí, vamos transformar o futuro da energia juntos? Se você se identificou com a nossa missão e acredita que tem o perfil para este desafio, queremos te conhecer! #Vem Pra Liora #Energia Simples #Transformação #Vendas Com Propósito

title: Virtual Executive Assistant – Family Owned Business Group
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Virtual Executive Assistant – Family Owned Business Group em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Summary

We are a family-owned business group overseeing a diversified portfolio of ventures across healthcare (medical practices), luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment production .

Our organization supports multiple senior executives who operate at the intersection of medicine, entrepreneurship, real estate, travel, and the performing arts . We are seeking a highly proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant to provide executive-level administrative and operational support across the group and help streamline day-to-day execution as our businesses continue to grow.


This is a unique opportunity to work closely with leadership across multiple industries , gaining exposure to complex operations, high-level decision-making, and creative as well as clinical environments.


Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize executive calendars across multiple businesses, including coordinating meetings across time zones and balancing competing priorities
  • Serve as a primary communication liaison , screening and prioritizing emails, calls, and messages to ensure timely and appropriate responses
  • Coordinate travel arrangements including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries for business and personal travel
  • Prepare meeting materials , agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up summaries to ensure action items are tracked and completed
  • Conduct research on vendors, partners, venues, travel options, market opportunities, and industry trends to support executive decision-making
  • Manage relationships with vendors and external service providers , including medical offices, travel partners, production vendors, accountants, and legal teams
  • Organize and maintain digital filing systems across multiple entities, ensuring documents are secure, accessible, and well categorized
  • Assist with special projects , including event coordination, content creation, process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-business initiatives
  • Handle personal administrative tasks as needed to support executive productivity and work-life balance

Qualifications

  • 2–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or similar high-level administrative role supporting senior leaders
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to represent executives professionally across industries
  • Highly resourceful and high-agency , with a demonstrated ability to anticipate needs and solve problems independently
  • Advanced proficiency with productivity tools including Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets) , Zapier, Zoom, and project management platforms
  • Strong organizational skills with experience managing complex schedules and competing priorities
  • Proven track record of maintaining strict confidentiality and exercising sound judgment with sensitive information
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup
  • Availability to work during overlapping U.S. Eastern Time hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting founders, physicians, or executives across multiple businesses
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, expense management, invoicing, and basic bookkeeping
  • Experience coordinating events, travel, or live productions
  • Comfort working in both clinical / professional and creative / entertainment environments
  • Bilingual capabilities (Spanish is a plus but not required)
  • Experience with Notion, Hubspot and Zapier

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with experience
  • Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership across healthcare, luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment
  • Exposure to a diversified business portfolio , not a single company role
  • Flexible, remote-first work environment with an emphasis on results over hours
  • Long-term growth potential for the right candidate who becomes a trusted operational partner

title: Sales Enablement Specialist, Digital Course & Access Programs
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sales Enablement Specialist, Digital Course & Access Programs em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of science video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role

JoVE is seeking a Sales Enablement Specialist - Digital Course Materials & Access Programs to support the operational delivery and adoption of JoVE’s digital science video platform across higher education institutions.

This role sits within the Sales Enablement team and focuses on managing course material adoptions, supporting bookstore affordability programs such as Inclusive Access and Equitable Access, and ensuring the reliable delivery of JoVE content through Learning Management Systems (LMS).

While JoVE’s Customer Success team works directly with faculty on course-level implementation, this role focuses on operational workflows, adoption tracking, data analysis, and identifying trends or systemic issues affecting digital course material delivery.

The ideal candidate combines strong operational and analytical skills with meaningful experience working with LMS platforms and LTI-based integrations used in higher education courseware delivery.


Responsibilities:

  • Manage course material adoptions and digital product fulfillment across higher education accounts.
  • Support the implementation and administration of Inclusive Access and Equitable Access programs with university bookstores.
  • Coordinate course setup and delivery of digital materials through bookstore distribution systems.
  • Analyze sales, adoption, and fulfillment data to create reports and dashboards that support forecasting, planning, and decision-making.
  • Provide insights to Sales leadership on adoption performance and program growth.
  • Identify trends, gaps, and opportunities in bookstore and digital distribution workflows.
  • Monitor workflows that support JoVE content delivery through Learning Management Systems (Canvas, Blackboard, Moodle, D2L, etc.). Recommend process improvements and system enhancements to support scalable program delivery.
  • Apply working knowledge of LTI integrations and LMS courseware delivery models to diagnose access or authentication issues.


Requirements

  • A Bachelor’s degree
  • 3+ years experience in EdTech, digital publishing, sales operations, or academic technology environments
  • Strong familiarity with Learning Management Systems (Canvas, Blackboard, Moodle, Brightspace, etc.)
  • Demonstrated experience working with LTI integrations or LMS-based courseware delivery
  • Strong experience using Salesforce or similar CRM platforms
  • Results-driven, strong organization and analytical skills
  • Ability to work independently in a fast paced environment


Why JoVE?

  • A competitive compensation package.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

title: Senior Mobile Developer
description:

Senior Mobile Developer


Role Purpose

As a Mobile Developer Senior Developer you will be responsible for architecting and building high performance enterprise grade mobile applications within the Experience Engineering and Digital Emerging Tech portfolios. This role focuses on leveraging React Native and the Salesforce Mobile SDK to deliver offline first data rich applications for a global FMCG leader.   • Salesforce Integration: Implement and customize mobile solutions using the Salesforce Mobile SDK ensuring seamless synchronization between mobile devices and Salesforce clouds
  • Offline Data Management: Architect Offline First capabilities using Smart Store DB, Salesforce SmartStore and SmartSync to manage complex local data persistence and synchronization
  • Computer Vision Integration: Implement image processing and computer vision features, eg shelf scanning asset recognition or document processing using OpenCV within the mobile environment
  • State Management: Manage complex application states and data flows using Redux or Redux Toolkit
  • Experience Engineering: Build highfidelity responsive UIs that provide superior user journeys for fieldforce users and consumers adhering to global brand standards
  • Version Control CI/CD: Manage source code branching strategies and pull requests using GitHub integrated with automated mobile build pipelines
  • Emerging Tech Pilots: Support Digital Emerging Technology initiatives by prototyping mobile first AIML features and integrating with hyper scaler hosted APIs eg GCP Vision AI
  • Senior Developer Specifics: Lead technical design for mobile modules perform rigorous code reviews, optimize app performance, memory battery and mentor junior developers in mobile best practices


Primary Skills Must-Have

  • Core Framework: Expert level proficiency in React Native JavaScriptTypeScript
  • Salesforce: Mobile Hands on experience with Salesforce Mobile SDK and Smart Store DB
  • State Management: Deep understanding of Redux for enterprisescale mobile apps
  • Computer Vision: Experience integrating OpenCV or similar CNative modules into React Native applications
  • Version Control: Advanced proficiency in GitHub workflows and Gitbased collaboration


Secondary Skills Good-to-Have

  • Native Modules: Ability to write Native Bridges in SwiftObjectiveC iOS or JavaKotlin Android
  • Hyperscaler Exposure: Experience connecting mobile apps to GCPAzure backend services Cloud Run App Services
  • Salesforce Platform: Familiarity with Apex SOQL and Salesforce Lightning Web Components LWC

  • FMCG Domain: Understanding of retail execution van sales or fieldforce automation workflows

title: Full Stack Engineer (Python/React/AI tools)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer (Python/React/AI tools) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our engineering team builds agentic solutions that data and research teams utilize to transform petabytes of raw data into strategic intelligence. Our resulting product delivers accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers — ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies — depend on to drive high-stakes decisions.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture — recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years — emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting — it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high — always with purpose and intention

About The Role

We’re looking for a seasoned, high-output engineer who can develop our rapidly growing agent platform for our Revenue organization. This individual will sit on our Infrastructure team that builds AI-native solutions used by the entire company to find, convert, and better enable customers with the products we launch. The ideal candidate possesses 3+ years of architecting and developing full-stack applications, proficient data analytics skills, strong interest in agentic workflows, and 5+ years working on applications or codebases built with Python, Databricks, React/JavaScript/TypeScript, and AWS.

You’ll be responsible for production-grade systems that our customers and internal teams depend on daily. That means being responsive, reliable, and an excellent communicator — both when things are going well and especially when they’re not.

The ideal candidate treats AI coding tools as core infrastructure for how they work — not a novelty. You’ve shipped full-stack applications, you’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, and you are customer-obsessed in your approach to improving software.

As a Senior Software Engineer, You Will

  • Own features and systems end-to-end across multiple product surfaces — architecture, implementation, deployment, and iteration
  • Architect and deliver solutions for our Revenue, Revenue Operations, and Business Development teams – including data tools, applications, and agentic orchestrators
  • Serve as a subject matter expert across the whole stack, and report directly to the Chief Architect, who will provide hands-on mentorship in cutting‑edge AI-native development, big data analytics, and cloud infrastructure.

Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil


Please send your resume in English!


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview


As a Backend Team Lead , you will play a key role in leading the backend development team while contributing to the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions that support the company's mission and goals. You will guide and support the backend team while working closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities


  • Team Leadership:

Lead and support the backend engineering team, ensuring effective collaboration, task distribution, and delivery of high-quality software.

  • Platform Development:

Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel , ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.

  • Database Development:

Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes.

  • API Development and Integration:

Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.

Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA , by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.

Competencies / Requirements

Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL . Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git .

  • Experience:

At least 6+ years of experience in backend development , with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Previous experience leading or mentoring developers is required. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.

Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.

title: Professor de Espanhol
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de Espanhol em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

description:

Job Title: Salesforce CRM Systems Analyst


Introduction: We are seeking a highly skilled Salesforce CRM Systems Analyst with 7 to 10 years of experience to join our dynamic team. This role is pivotal in optimizing and managing our Salesforce ecosystem, driving business growth through effective CRM solutions. The ideal candidate will leverage their expertise in Sales Cloud , application administration , integration , and AI-led automation to enhance user experience, streamline processes, and deliver actionable insights. This position plays a critical role in aligning Salesforce capabilities with organizational goals, ensuring seamless collaboration across departments and maximizing CRM value.


Roles and Responsibilities:


  • Lead the administration and configuration of the Salesforce Sales Cloud platform to support business processes and user requirements.
  • Design, develop, and implement integrations between Salesforce and third-party systems to ensure data consistency and process automation.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather and analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable Salesforce solutions.
  • Manage and optimize Salesforce application administration tasks including user management, security roles, profiles, workflows, and validation rules.
  • Drive AI-led automation initiatives within Salesforce to enhance sales productivity and decision-making using tools such as Einstein Analytics and AI-driven workflows .
  • Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and implement enhancements to maintain optimal CRM functionality.
  • Develop training materials and conduct user training sessions to promote adoption and effective use of Salesforce features.

  • Collaborate closely with IT, sales, marketing, and customer service teams to ensure Salesforce supports cross-functional business needs.

Qualifications:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 7 to 10 years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Systems Analyst or Administrator with a focus on Sales Cloud .
  • Salesforce certifications such as Salesforce Certified Administrator , Salesforce Certified Sales Cloud Consultant , or equivalent are highly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience in application administration, configuration, and customization of Salesforce environments.
  • Proven expertise in integrating Salesforce with external applications using APIs, middleware, or integration platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of AI-led automation tools within Salesforce, including Einstein Analytics and process automation capabilities.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to work collaboratively across teams.

Tools and Technologies:

  • AI-led Automation Tools (Salesforce Einstein, Einstein Analytics, AI-driven Process Automation)
  • Data Management and Reporting tools within Salesforce
  • Familiarity with Agile project management software (e.g., Jira, Confluence)

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Information Technology Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview


Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.


Key Responsibilities


Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)

  • Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes.
  • Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes.
  • Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations.
  • Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools.

Automation, Integration & AI Implementation

  • Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript).
  • Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks.
  • Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.

IT Administration & Security

  • Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365).
  • Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access.
  • Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security.
  • Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.


Required Qualifications & Skills


Technical Experience:

  • 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures.
  • High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting.
  • Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows.
  • Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.


Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:

  • Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity.
  • Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms.
  • Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.


Benefits & Compensation

  • Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading cryptocurrency exchange, serving over 20 million users worldwide. BingX offers diversified products and services, including spot, derivatives, copy trading, and asset management – all designed for the evolving needs of users, from beginners to professionals.


BingX is committed to providing a trustworthy platform that empowers users with innovative tools and features to elevate their trading proficiency.


Our current vacancy | Full-time | Long-term | REMOTE

The Senior Compliance Manager will join the global legal and compliance team, with a primary focus on Brazil and the broader Latin American regulatory landscape. This role requires a proactive self-starter with a strong interest in financial innovation and digital assets, who thrives in a cross-functional, fast-paced environment. The successful candidate will lead regulatory and licensing efforts related to crypto operations in Brazil while supporting regional expansion initiatives.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead regulatory compliance strategy and licensing/registration efforts for crypto-related activities in Brazil, including engagement with the Central Bank of Brazil (BCB), Comissão de Valores Mobiliários (CVM), and other relevant authorities
  • Monitor and interpret developments in Brazil’s crypto regulatory framework (e.g., Law No. 14,478/2022 and related regulations), and assess their impact on business operations
  • Act as the primary project manager for licensing and regulatory initiatives, coordinating with external counsel, consultants, and internal stakeholders
  • Provide clear, practical, and solution-oriented compliance guidance to product, operations, and business teams to enable compliant product launches and expansion
  • Deliver internal training programs and update training materials to reflect regulatory changes and best practices
  • Represent the company in interactions with regulators, financial institutions, partners, and industry groups in Brazil


Knowledge:

  • Strong understanding of Brazil’s crypto and financial regulatory environment, including digital asset frameworks and payment systems (e.g., PIX)
  • Familiarity with AML/CFT regulations, data protection (LGPD), and financial consumer protection laws in Brazil
  • Experience in the crypto, fintech, or payments industry is highly preferred
  • Understanding of global regulatory trends in digital assets is a plus


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Law, Finance, Business, or a related field
  • 7 to 9 years of regulatory compliance experience, with at least 3 years focused on crypto, fintech, payments, or financial services in Brazil
  • Proven experience handling regulatory licensing, compliance frameworks, and regulator engagement in Brazil
  • Ability to advise on regulatory implications for product design, modification, and market expansion
  • Strong ability to navigate a dynamic and evolving regulatory landscape with ambiguity
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills and ability to work cross-functionally with senior management
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to remain composed under pressure
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Portuguese (Mandarin is a plus but not required)
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively and deliver practical, scalable compliance solutions
  • Proficiency in MS Office applications


Working at BingX

  • Join an international and diversified team
  • Great career development in a fast-growing company
  • Be part of the future of finance technology and achieve meaningful goals
  • Competitive market salary and fully remote/work-from-home flexibility
  • Flexibility to observe your local holiday calendar, alongside additional benefit

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. title: Lead Full-Stack Developer (.Net+Angular)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Full-Stack Developer (.Net+Angular) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

LUXOFT ONLY OPERATES UNDER CLT CONTRACT

PLEASE APPLY WITH YOUR ENGLISH CV


The Mission

We are building the next generation of real-time solutions for our Risk Management and Portfolio Management teams. This isn’t just maintenance; you will be part of a small, elite agile squad of technologists tasked with re-engineering how we handle high-throughput, latency-sensitive financial data.

We value the \"Full Lifecycle Engineer\"—someone who takes pride in owning a feature from the initial whiteboard sketch and requirements gathering through to implementation, automated testing, and production monitoring.


Technical DNA

We are looking for a specialist in the .NET ecosystem who treats performance as a feature, not an afterthought. You should possess:

  • Architectural Mastery: A deep obsession with Clean Architecture , SOLID principles, and design patterns. You believe code should be as readable as it is fast.
  • Performance Engineering: Real-world experience building Low-Latency/High-Throughput systems. You know how to find bottlenecks using profiling tools and how to mitigate them.
  • The Concurrent Mindset: Expertise in TPL (Async/Await) and a deep understanding of thread safety and synchronization. You don't just use lock; you understand why you're using it.
  • Data at Scale: Mastery of SQL Server performance tuning, from execution plans to index optimization, ensuring our data layer scales with our ambitions.

The Toolkit (Must-Haves)

  • Core: C# / .NET 8 (or ASP.NET Core)
  • Patterns: Clean Architecture, DI/IoC (Autofac/Microsoft), Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Data: SQL Server, T-SQL, Stored Procedures, and Query Tuning.
  • Infrastructure: Distributed Systems, Microservices, and Cloud-native design.
  • Reliability: Monitoring & Observability (App Insights/Prometheus), Memory Management (GC Tuning).
  • Operations: Full SDLC ownership, including CI/CD and Production Support.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • You have an independent mindset but crave a collaborative environment.
  • You have a \"Builder\" mentality—you enjoy solving the complex math and logic behind Risk Management.
  • You don't just fix bugs; you identify systemic risks and propose architectural improvements.


LUXOFT ONLY OPERATES UNDER CLT CONTRACT

Desenvolver estudos e análises complexas, relacionados às atividades no campo da engenharia de processos, respondendo por identificar e quantificar recursos minerais, desenvolvendo projetos de beneficiamento de minérios e metalurgia de terras raras e elementos estratégicos, por meio da realização de estudos técnicos e análises críticas de processos, para viabilizar a produção sustentável de minérios e compostos metálicos com abrangência em toda a operação da empresa, e garantir implementação de melhorias em processos e novas tecnologias.


RESPONSABILIDADES DO CARGO

Suportar as atividades de pesquisa e desenvolvimento de rotas de processo de beneficiamento mineral e metalurgia aplicáveis ao processo de produção de elementos de terras raras e minerais estratégicos em escala de bancada, piloto e industrial, visando otimização e inovação.


Acompanhar a realização de testes metalúrgicos de beneficiamento mineral ou metalurgia em laboratórios internos, externos e Centros de Pesquisa, garantindo a qualidade dos processos e atendendo às demandas de P&D da empresa.


Revisar documentação de projetos de beneficiamento mineral e metalurgia nas diversas fases (Scoping Study até Feasibility Study), apoiando na elaboração e revisão de fluxogramas de processo e engenharia, com o objetivo de assegurar a precisão técnica dos estudos.


Atuar de forma consultiva juntamente ao corpo técnico, direcionando na elaboração e execução de programas de testes metalúrgicos e na avaliação e consolidação de informações de processos, contribuindo para a eficiência operacional.


Elaborar e revisar relatórios e apresentações para suportar as decisões da Gerência de Processos e P&D, comunicando os resultados de forma clara e objetiva para a tomada de decisões estratégicas.


Apoiar a equipe de Engenharia, Engenharia de Minas e PMO nos estudos da disciplina de Processos para planta de beneficiamento mineral e hidrometalurgia, fornecendo suporte técnico e contribuindo para a resolução de problemas.


Cumprir e fazer cumprir as normas e metas de Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente, promovendo uma cultura organizacional de responsabilidade e prevenção.


Participar ativamente na formação e desenvolvimento da equipe técnica, disseminando conhecimentos e melhorando as competências do time em processos de beneficiamento mineral.


REQUISITOS DO CARGO

Formação Acadêmica: Graduação em Engenharia de Minas, Engenharia Química, Engenharia Metalúrgica e outras afins.


Idioma: Inglês Intermediário/Avançado


Disponibilidade para residir em Salvador/BA ou Lauro de Freitas/BA.

Disponibilidade para atuar eventualmente em regime de turno.


Competências Técnicas: Sólidos conhecimentos em processos metalúrgicos, beneficiamento mineral, elaboração de estudos de viabilidade, gerenciamento de projetos e domínio de softwares de modelagem de processos.


COMPETÊNCIAS COMPORTAMENTAIS

Proatividade, orientação para resultados, habilidades de comunicação, trabalho em equipe, capacidade de análise crítica, resolução de problemas complexos, flexibilidade e espírito inovador.
